highlights.title: Agents see what you attach
highlights.line: An agent now sees each file you attach with its type and size, and an image's dimensions, before it opens it.

highlights.title: Choose who hears about a missed run
highlights.line: A repeating task can now name who to tell when a run is missed: you, or an agent on the project.

highlights.title: Claude agents stop pausing for permission
highlights.line: From their next start, Claude agents go ahead past permission prompts. What you set to never allow stays blocked; their questions show.

highlights.title: Scheduled tasks no longer read as unassigned
highlights.line: A repeating task with nobody on it now shows under On a schedule in Tasks, not Unassigned. If an agent should run it, give it to one.
